name: C/C++ dev tooling (clang, cmake, ninja, lldb, helix)
description: Installs a C/C++ build toolchain via pixi: clang/clang++, cmake, ninja, make, pkg-config, ccache, the lldb and gdb debuggers, plus clangd (via clang-tools) and the Helix editor - Helix's own default language config already pairs C/C++ with clangd, so no extra wiring is needed. Works with both base-ubuntu and base-cuda images.
